title: "Daily Translation: Losing Track of Time at the Library"
author: "Ryan Sun"
date: "2026-09-07"

---

## 中文原文

下午你在图书馆看书，看得太投入忘记时间。等你合上书，才发现图书馆快要闭馆。收拾好随身物品出门，才发现外面刮起大风，你赶紧快步走向地铁站。

## My translation

I was reading books at the library this afternoon. I was so focused that I forgot the time. Not until I closed the book, I realized the library was going to be closed. I packed up my belongings and stepped outside, then I found it was windy, so I headed fast to the subway station.

## Revised version

I was reading at the library this afternoon. I got so absorbed that I lost track of time. Not until I closed my book did I realize the library was about to close. I gathered my things and stepped outside, only to find it was windy. I hurried toward the subway station.

## Key phrases

- **got so absorbed**：看得十分投入，比 *so focused* 更贴合看书场景
- **lost track of time**：忘记时间，日常高频地道短语，替代 *forgot the time*
- **only to find…**：结果却发现……，用来引出意外情况，叙事感很强
- **hurried toward**：快步赶往
